notes: Machine-readable encoding of the Atlas Funded Access account rules gathered from official Atlas pages on 2026-10-16. status is one of verified-official | conflict | unverified. A rule with needed_for_enforcement=true and status != verified-official is REFUSED by src.atlas.rules.load_rules unless the caller explicitly lists it in allow_unverified. Fractions are expressed as decimals (0.10 = 10%).

profit_target_pct.note: Evaluation target = 3% of start balance, measured on CLOSED balance. No target when funded.

max_drawdown_pct.note: TRAILING on EQUITY. Atlas formula (verified 2026-10-26): Floor = highest_equity_ever * (1 - limit). Engine uses: floor = peak - limit * initial_balance, which is MORE conservative when peak > initial (higher floor = less room). After payout: re-anchored to post-payout balance.

daily_loss_pct.note: Trailing, end-of-day. Funded base = previous day's highest equity/balance. Resets 00:00 UTC.

daily_loss_reset_utc.note: Daily loss limit resets at 00:00 UTC.

daily_loss_eod_computation.value: atlas_official: floor = equity_at_reset * (1 - limit). Engine uses conservative: ref = previous UTC day's highest equity/balance; limit_usd = daily_loss_pct * min(initial_balance, ref); floor = ref - limit_usd
daily_loss_eod_computation.note: Atlas daily-loss page (verified 2026-10-26): 'Daily floor = Equity at 00:00 UTC x (1 - limit)'. Resets at 00:00 UTC. Profit during the day does NOT raise today's floor. The engine uses a TIGHTER formula (min of initial and ref as base) which is always stricter than Atlas. Safe for real money.

min_trading_days_evaluation.note: No minimum trading days in the evaluation. No consistency rule in the evaluation.

activation_window_days.note: Must activate (pay funded fee) within 30 days of passing.

payout_min_profit_days.note: Funded: at least 3 trading days each with >= 0.5% profit per payout cycle. min_day_profit_pct is in PERCENT units (0.5 = 0.5%).

payout_consistency_best_day_max_share.note: Best day <= 40% of cycle profit at payout request. Breach delays the payout; it does not breach the account.

first_on_demand_payout_split.note: Access page says 90%; Terms are read as capping the first on-demand payout at 50%. Unresolved - ask Atlas support in writing. Do not budget with 90% for the first on-demand payout.

payout_schedule.note: First payout after 28 days then every 14 days; $100 profit threshold.

atlas_protector.note: Net floating loss of 2% of INITIAL balance closes all positions and cuts the split to 50% for that cycle; second occurrence = breach. Documented under funded; the engine applies it in both phases (stricter).

news_window_minutes.note: +/-5 min around high-impact events: profit of trades opened/closed inside the window is deducted (funded).

margin_usage_close_pct.note: margin/(margin+free margin) >= 80% closes all positions and deducts profit on those closed in profit (funded).

inactivity_limit_days.note: At least one trade within 30 days.

weekend_new_positions_allowed.note: No NEW positions on Saturday/Sunday (UTC); holding across the weekend is allowed.

per_instrument_risk_max_share_of_daily_l.note: Funded: risk on a single instrument <= 50% of the daily-loss limit.

max_leverage_rule.note: Leverage up to 1:100 per the rules pages.

mt5_server_leverage.note: Evaluation: 1:100. Funded MT5 accounts: 1:50 (each position needs twice the margin). TradeLocker/Match-Trader funded stays 1:100.

gold_symbol.note: Gold symbol name on the Atlas MT5 server (XAUUSD / XAUUSD.x / GOLD) is not published.

funded_fee_usd_by_size.note: Funded activation fee per account size not captured.

eas_allowed.note: EAs / algorithmic trading are allowed per the Prohibited-practices page.

ea_approval_required.value: no approval needed: EAs and algorithmic trading are allowed within the rules
ea_approval_required.note: Platforms page (read 2026-10-31): 'Expert Advisors (EAs) are allowed. You are still responsible for every trade they place, including short trades and news windows on funded accounts.' Prohibited-practices page: 'Allowed: Expert Advisors and algorithmic trading, within the rules.' No approval step on either page; owner confirmed. Was 'conflict' (old Terms wording) until 2026-10-31.

vpn_policy.value: allowed with advance disclosure of location changes

prohibited_practices.note: Not enforceable from account data alone; operational policy.

fee_refund.note: The $5 fee is refunded with the 3rd consecutive payout; the funded fee is not refunded.
